'''Bernadette Charleux''' is a French [[polymer chemistry|polymer chemist]]. She is a member of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref name = ae>{{cite web |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Charleux_Bernadette |title=Academy of Europe Charleux Bernadette|publisher=[[Academia Europaea]] |access-date=2019-05-03}}</ref> and a senior member of the [[Institut universitaire de France]] since 2009.<ref>{{cite web
 |url=http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/123-bernadette-charleux.html
 |title=Bernadette Charleux
 |publisher=[[Institut universitaire de France]]
 |access-date=2019-05-03
 |language=French}}</ref> Since 2012, she is the Deputy Vice-president of Research and Development at [[Saint-Gobain]].<ref name = ae/>

== Scientific work==
Bernadette Charleux first worked on [[emulsion polymerization]], which led to the creation of new materials :  functional [[latex]]es, [[amphiphile|amphiphilic]] copolymers, etc. before turning to pioneering research on [[Reversible-deactivation radical polymerization]] in aqueous media. More recently, she has worked on the creation of nano-objects via the [[self-assembly]] of macromolecules.<ref>{{cite journal
 |title=Polymerization-Induced Self-Assembly: From Soluble Macromolecules to Block Copolymer Nano-Objects in One Step
 |journal=Macromolecules
 |volume=45
 |issue=17
 |pages=6753–6765
 |publisher=[[American Chemical Society|ACS]]
 |doi=10.1021/ma300713f
 |year=2012
 |last1=Charleux
 |first1=Bernadette
 |last2=Delaittre
 |first2=Guillaume
 |last3=Rieger
 |first3=Jutta
 |last4=d'Agosto
 |first4=Franck
 |bibcode=2012MaMol..45.6753C
 }}</ref>

This work has led to numerous patents.<ref>[http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/recherche/prix/docs/argent2012/Charleux.pdf Bernadette Charleux - Quand la chimie des polymères conduit à l’innovation] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161020191415/http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/recherche/prix/docs/argent2012/Charleux.pdf |date=2016-10-20 }}, CNRS, 2012.</ref>
